verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only an import capability: the import-and-export knowledge pages describe importing records and self-service transfer into HubSpot. Nothing describes a first-party export or data-portability feature that produces open formats. CRM API read access (contacts sync, batch retrieval of custom object records) and the MCP server are developer building blocks a user could use to construct an export, not a documented 'export all data and leave' capability, so they earn no credit.
